question: The mean proportional between ( {7 + 2sqrt 5 } ) and ( {21 - 6sqrt 5 } ) is:
solution:
**Given:**

1st Number= ( {7 + 2sqrt 5 } )

2nd Number= ( {21 - 6sqrt 5 } )

**Formula Used:**

Mean Proportional = sqrt{1st Numbertimes 2nd Number}

**Calculations:**

According to the formula 

⇒ 1st Number x 2nd Number = ( {7 + 2sqrt 5 } ) x ( {21 - 6sqrt 5 } ) =147 -42sqrt5+42sqrt5 -12×5 = 147 - 60 = 87

⇒ Mean Proportional = sqrt{1st Numbertimes 2nd Number} = sqrt{87}

**Hence, The Mean Proportional of the two numbers will be sqrt{87}**
